name: folk
summary: Lightweight, collaborative CRM for managing contacts and relationships. Centralize your network and personalize outreach without the bloat. A mobile app (Contacts by folk) adds on-the-go search, one-tap contact capture with business-card scanning, voice notes and interaction tracking across WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and calendar.
best_for: small sales teams, agencies and VC/partnership teams who want a clean, fast-to-set-up CRM with a great LinkedIn enrichment extension
skip_if: you need real multi-step workflow automation and reporting, or you are on Standard and want Zapier, Make or the REST API — folk keeps those for Premium and up, and is lightweight by design
honest_knock: One gap has closed and one has narrowed. folk now has a mobile app — the pricing table carries a Mobile app row ticked on all three plans — so the browser-only complaint is out of date. Automation is still uneven, but the picture moved in September: Zapier and Make stay Premium and Enterprise only, and so does the REST API, yet the table now carries an MCP row ticked on all three plans. Standard therefore does have a programmatic route — through an AI client rather than a workflow builder — and no plan shows a native multi-step workflow. Enrichment is capped at 500 a month on Standard and 1,000 on Premium, and email sequences need at least Premium.

pricing.notes: $30/member/month on Standard, $60 on Premium and from $100 on Enterprise when billed monthly; billed yearly those drop to $24, $48 and from $80 per member per month — 20% off — for $288, $576 and $960 per member per year (re-verified 2026-09-03; every figure held). The same page publishes euro rates: 27€, 54€ and from 83€ monthly, 22€, 43€ and from 67€ yearly, for 259€, 518€ and 804€ a year. The free trial is two weeks and needs no credit card; folk's own FAQ says an account that does not upgrade is blocked rather than deleted at the end, and that the trial can be extended by a week on request. The published caps: email enrichment 500 a month on Standard, 1,000 on Premium and custom on Enterprise; AI magic fields 2,000 and 5,000; account sync one per member and five per member.
